subject: MdeModulePkg/SpiNorFlashJedecSfdp: Limit debug output
reasons: Mechanical substitution of DEBUG_INFO with DEBUG_VERBOSE in 5 DEBUG() macro call sites within a single file
The pattern is simple and well-defined: replace the debug level argument from DEBUG_INFO to DEBUG_VERBOSE in entry-point debug prints for SPI NOR Flash operations
While confined to one file in this commit, the pattern (DEBUG_INFO -> DEBUG_VERBOSE for verbose/entry-trace messages) is conceptually repeatable across many drivers
The change is purely structural with no case-by-case reasoning needed per call site
candidate_pattern:
@@
expression msg, args;
@@
- DEBUG((DEBUG_INFO, msg, args))
+ DEBUG((DEBUG_VERBOSE, msg, args))
